versification: R. H. Charles source numbering normalized to logical chapters 1-108 and contiguous integer verses; lettered subverses and parallel E/G^g readings are preserved in merged text/source_parts

verses.text_en:
Oh that mine eyes were [a cloud of] waters
That I might weep over you,
And pour down my tears as a cloud †of† waters:
That so I might rest from my trouble of heart!
verses.text_hr: O, kad bi moje oči bile [oblak] vode, da mogu plakati nad vama i izliti suze poput oblaka †punog† vode, pa da mi se srce odmori od muke!

verses.text_en:
†Who has permitted you to practise reproaches and wickedness?
And so judgement shall overtake you, sinners.†
verses.text_hr: †Tko vam je dopustio činiti prijekore i zloću? Zato će vas, grešnici, stići sud.†
Ne bojte se grešnika, vi pravednici; Jer opet će ih Gospodin predati u vaše ruke, Da biste nad njima mogli izvršiti presudu prema svojim željama.

verses.text_en:
Woe to you who fulminate anathemas which cannot be reversed:
Healing shall therefore be far from you because of your sins.
verses.text_hr: Jao vama koji bacate anateme koje se ne mogu poništiti: Liječenje će stoga biti daleko od vas zbog vaših grijeha.

verses.text_en:
Woe to you who requite your neighbour with evil;
For ye shall be requited according to your works.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama koji bližnjemu uzvraćate zlom; Jer ćete biti plaćeni po svojim djelima.

verses.text_en:
Woe to you, lying witnesses,
And to those who weigh out injustice,
For suddenly shall ye perish.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama, lažljivi svjedoci, i onima koji vagaju nepravdu, Jer iznenada ćete nestati.
Teško vama, grešnici, što progonite pravednike; Jer ćete biti predani i progonjeni zbog nepravde, i težak će jaram njegov biti na vama.
